result.summary: All four legacy deferred Sep23/24 walks were reconciled STRICTLY SERIALLY (per entry: fresh authority+state read, fresh dry run bound to that entry, apply from that dry run's facts, immediate read-only verification, idempotency replay) under Server e88b8ef7 and workout policy v4 [cardio,strength]. Each dry run returned dry_run predicting exactly four mutations (canonical workout create + coexistence, observation reconciliation update, one audit row); each apply returned applied; each verification and the final invariant audit passed. Four canonical Cardio 'walking' workouts (generic — none stored isIndoorWorkout; Indoor/Outdoor NOT inferred) now exist with telemetry equal to the stored observations. Whole-day canonical Activity totals are byte-identical (Sep23 782.698 kcal, Sep24 914.709 kcal, rev unchanged); workout attribution changed only by each walk's retained active energy (Sep23 workout 320.5->506.3, non-workout 462.2->276.4; Sep24 workout none->345.7, non-workout 568.99) with no double counting. No Logger session/link/claim for Cardio; Strength workouts, links (2) and claims (4) unchanged; 32 of 35 strategic digests identical (the 3 that changed are the reconciliation-owned HealthKit training collections); policy record unchanged; migrations unchanged; production healthy; no error logs. Indoor-vs-Outdoor fidelity remains untested by the historical four and awaits the first new prospective Cardio workout with isIndoorWorkout metadata.

tests.summary: No code changed; reviewed reconciliation runner and read-only audit payloads were used.

review.summary: Operational gates using previously reviewed tooling with hard per-stage assertions; each entry independently verified by a separate read-only production read.

zero_write_audit.summary: Reads were BEGIN REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY. The only writes were the four guarded reconciliations (each: one canonical workout + coexistence patch, one observation reconciliation update, one audit row).

decisions_required: Founder real-device acceptance of Build 60 Activity Detail: Sep23 and Sep24 each show two historical Cardio workout rows (generic Walking/Cardio expected), whole-day totals unchanged, Strength detail healthy.

The auto-mode classifier required a plain-words Founder chat confirmation before the four serial production writes.
